description: Saves any text-based file (SVG, XML, HTML, JSON, CSV, Markdown) as a plain .txt file that contains its source code. Use at the end of a pipeline when the result must be a txt, for example cgm to svg to txt.

input_file.description: any text-based file (svg, xml, html, json, csv, markdown)

output_txt.description: the same content as a .txt file
